transactionbodycustomfield.description: The request_uuid of the most recent Middleware call about this record. Each inbound call carries its own; this holds the latest, so the record points at the Sync Log row for the call that last touched it. NOT the duplicate guard - the FIRST call's request_uuid lives in the native externalId, where the platform enforces uniqueness per record type, and it is never overwritten. This field is a convenience copy and must never be used to test for a duplicate.
